title: bromus loliaceus
intro: Bromus loliaceus, commonly known as Brome grass or Smooth Brome, is a perennial grass native to Europe, Asia, and Western North America. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that aid in reducing fever, relieving coughs, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Bromus loliaceus include its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve gastrointestinal issues, as well as its potential to exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of Bromus loliaceus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
